changes: Core Work list/detail/review no longer waits for optional roster or shared Doc choices.
Plain Work list starts no roster or Doc scan; composer requests both, detail requests typed people, purpose/proposal requests exact shared Doc choices.
Picker states distinguish idle/loading/unavailable and complete ready data; actor remains unknown until typed roster succeeds.
Denied current picker read hides current Work content; stale scope/session/epoch or A-B-A replies cannot publish or invoke current access callbacks.
Original prepared requests and drafts are untouched; required Doc proposal still requires exact matching target revision/hash.

new_tests: plain list and ordinary detail request no Doc scan and configuration never performs a read
deferred optional choices leave title-only unassigned command preparation independent
same-scope picker failure is unavailable until an explicit retry returns complete typed data
current optional denial closes the scoped view and prevents a second deferred picker publication
optional reads fence A to B to A late successes and denials by view generation
optional reads cannot publish after opaque session or authority identity changes
optional read completion after unmount cannot publish or invoke an access callback

limitations: No carrier/native qualification or deployment claim.
The original Work/Doc/actual-v10 browser fixtures remain immutable; this new integration has not been rendered in an actual browser.
Host tests exercise the optional loader, gating and canonical preparation boundaries; they do not establish native acceptance.
